subject: Discrepancy in the Section 26 51 00 light fixture type between Sheet E-501 and One-Line

messages.text: Coordination review turned up a mismatch on the Section 26 51 00 light fixture type between One-Line Diagram E-002 and Sheet E-501 -- can you confirm which is correct before we release for fabrication? No rush on this -- please respond when convenient. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. This could affect the electrical rough-in schedule. Please respond at your earliest convenience. We can't tie this to a firm date on our end -- it depends on when the panel vendor gets back to us, and they haven't given a timeline.
